description: Snap's estimate of how many people a targeting can reach, BEFORE spending (read-only, nothing is created). Give adsquad_id for an existing ad squad, or the targeting (countries, ages, gender, interests, os, segments) for one you are planning. Says whether the audience is very small, small, OK or very broad.

adsquad_id.description: Ad squad id. Get it from snap_list_adsquads.

exclude_segment_ids.description: Ids of audiences to leave out. Get them from snap_list_segments.

gender.description: MALE, FEMALE or leave empty for everyone.

include_segment_ids.description: Ids of audiences to target. Get them from snap_list_segments.

interests.description: Interest ids such as SLC_11 (see snap_targeting_options)

max_age.description: Oldest age, up to 50 (50 means 50 and over).

os_type.description: iOS or ANDROID, or leave empty for both.

name: snap_audience_size
